features.label: Obsession as a system
features.detail: The work ethic was a documented, repeatable method rather than a temperament.

features.label: Not universally liked
features.detail: Alienated teammates and was difficult by many accounts. The single-mindedness had casualties.

features.label: The 2003 case
features.detail: Any honest study includes it. Hagiography here is a failure of the exercise, not a kindness.
